result.title: $Σ$-LeWM: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control
result.summary: World models have increasingly been applied as a model-based control method for robotics tasks such as manipulation and locomotion. While early world model architectures relied on decoders to prevent mode collapse and learn a predictable latent space, recent works on world models, such as Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture or LeWorldModel, increasingly aim to learn embeddings without a grounding decoder, utilising only a latent forward dynamics predictor and a stabilising entropy term. In this paper, we set out to demonstrate that the further introduction of two additional latent losses to LeWorldModel, a backward dynamics predictor and an inverse dynamics action predictor, enforces further structure on the latent embedding, leading to further gains in both performance and planning efficiency. These are critical properties for improving the applicability of such methods to real-time model-based control of real-world robots. We demonstrate these gains on standard world model benchmarks and two simulated robot manipulation tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在无解码器的 LeWorldModel 上增加反向动力学预测器与逆动力学动作预测器两项 latent 损失，以强化潜在嵌入结构，并在标准世界模型基准和两个仿真机器人操作任务上考察控制性能与规划效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「无解码器但需保持可预测且信息充分的潜在状态」问题与 LVR 中视觉 latent 是否保留任务必要信息、信息坍缩及辅助监督设计相通，正/逆向动力学损失可能为潜状态内容约束提供可核查线索，但机器人控制设定与多模态推理的关联尚待确认。
